prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) tend to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-1.5% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test, and predictions were generally overly optimistic across most tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Preview Tip Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining desktop controls and how the pet will appear once ready. (why: The home stage takes a long median/mean wait time (201s / 2336s), and 3 support emails reported confusion about desktop pet visibility and controls.)
1: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Layout: Re-layout the pick_friend screen using a full_bleed presentation style with clearer action prompts. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s).)
2: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Grid Layout Focus: Switch choose_path layout to grid format and add step counter indicators to clarify onboarding progression. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and takes 514s mean time, signaling ambiguity in path options.)
3: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Guidance Callout Component: Add a prominent visual hint and advice banner to upload_photos regarding photo clarity and camera angles. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to bad source images.)
4: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Notification Opt-In Toggle: Enable background notifications and estimated time display on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app. (why: Generation wait times average 2336s, causing users to get stuck or abandon the desktop window prematurely.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Overview New Screen: Insert a dedicated overview screen before home_intro that illustrates desktop placement, drag controls, and tray shortcuts. (why: Multiple support tickets show post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling, hiding, or talking to pets.)
